findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "save_template" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Save a design to QRdx as a saved theme, listed under Themes in the dashboard and offered in the editor. Needs a QRdx API key with full access on this MCP connec…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: design_qr, generate_qr_code · Private data: design_qr, generate_qr_code, save_template, qr_payload_vcard · Public sink: design_qr, qr_payload_email, qr_payload_sms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: design_qr, generate_qr_code · Private data: design_qr, generate_qr_code, save_template, qr_payload_vcard · Public sink: design_qr, qr_payload_email, qr_payload_sms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
